title: Add TikTok + LinkedIn Insight Tag pixels for paid attribution
body:
## Summary
Wires TikTok Pixel + LinkedIn Insight Tag into the root layout for paid-ads attribution.

## Why
Marketing-stack v0 pilot launches paid ads on TikTok + LinkedIn ($125/mo each). Without pixel tracking we can't attribute trial signups back to ad creative or measure CAC. Pilot scoreboard depends on this attribution signal.

## What changed
- **New:** `src/components/analytics/MarketingPixels.tsx` — Next.js `<Script strategy="afterInteractive">` for TikTok Pixel + LinkedIn Insight Tag (init + loader + noscript pixel). Conditional render on env vars.
- **Edited:** `src/app/layout.tsx` — mount `<MarketingPixels />` inside `<body>`, above `{children}`.

## Env vars to set (Vercel + .env.local)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID` — from TikTok Ads Manager → Assets → Events
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID` — from LinkedIn Campaign Manager → Analyze → Insight Tag

Both are `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` because pixel IDs are public — they identify which ad account receives events, not how to authenticate. Safe to ship client-side.

## Test plan
- [ ] Set both env vars on Vercel
- [ ] Deploy preview
- [ ] Open preview URL with TikTok Pixel Helper extension → confirm pixel fires
- [ ] Open preview URL with LinkedIn Insight Tag Helper extension → confirm tag fires
- [ ] Confirm no console errors when env vars are absent (renders null)

## Design source
`C:\Answer\projects\dscribe-marketing-stack.md` §14 (pilot scope) + §4 (attribution mechanics)
